purpose: A frequent primary action paired with a menu of related alternatives.
behaviorProvider: Shared Button and DropdownMenu with local guarded async action state.

component: Render independent primary and menu Buttons in a named group. Alternative actions are mapped to DropdownMenu with stable ids and per-action disabled/intent settings.
Guard primary and alternative execution synchronously against duplicate calls. Close the menu, clear the prior error, and disable actions during pending work or external loading.
host: Supply stable unique action ids, contextual labels and real async promises. Own persistence, permissions and retry/idempotency policy.
Keep the primary action semantically stable; menu choices do not automatically replace it.

requirements.statement: Render independent primary and menu Buttons in a named group. Alternative actions are mapped to DropdownMenu with stable ids and per-action disabled/intent settings.
Guard primary and alternative execution synchronously against duplicate calls. Close the menu, clear the prior error, and disable actions during pending work or external loading.
On rejection retain the component, show errorMessage in an alert and call onActionError. The host callback owns the operation result.
After pending ends, attempt to restore focus to the initiating primary/menu button only while focus remains within the group or on the document body. Avoid local state updates after unmount.
Supply stable unique action ids, contextual labels and real async promises. Own persistence, permissions and retry/idempotency policy.
Keep the primary action semantically stable; menu choices do not automatically replace it.

Use trigger group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No transaction rollback, confirmation flow or network cancellation is supplied.
There is no externally controlled menu or pending state; loading is an additional availability input.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
